WITH z_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.abhvreg,
        ab.peercorr,
        CASE 
            WHEN STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) IS NULL OR STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE (ab.peercorr - AVG(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind)) / STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind)
        END as normalized_score
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
)
SELECT abhvreg, peercorr, normalized_score FROM z_scores LIMIT 5;

-- Verify no NULL normalized scores exist

            ELSE (ab.peercorr - AVG(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind)) / STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind)
        END as normalized_score
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(normalized_score) as non_null, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normalized_score = 0) as zero_scores FROM z_scores;
